mapper.select: SELECT a.daily_date ,ISNULL(b.inQty, 0) AS inQty ,ISNULL(b.returnQty, 0) AS returnQty ,ISNULL(b.disQty, 0) AS discardQty ,ISNULL(b.outQty, 0) AS ospQty ,ISNULL(c.prodQty, 0) AS prodQty ,ISNULL(d.usePrice, 0) AS useQty ,a.daily_id ,a.end_yn ,a.reg_id ,a.type_cd FROM tb_daily_mst a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT daily_id ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'A' THEN ISNULL(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS inQty ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'P' THEN ISNULL(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS returnQty ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'G' THEN ISNULL(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS disQty ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'Z' THEN ISNULL(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS outQty FROM tb_daily_M1 GROUP BY daily_id ) b ON a.daily_id = b.daily_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT daily_id ,SUM(ISNULL(qty, 0)) AS prodQty FROM tb_daily_prod GROUP BY daily_id ) c ON a.daily_id = c.daily_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT daily_id ,SUM(ISNULL(required_quantity, 0) * ISNULL(in_price, 0)) AS usePrice FROM tb_daily_item_use GROUP BY daily_id ) d ON a.daily_id = d.daily_id WHERE a.daily_date between #{strDate} and #{endDate} and a.type_cd = 'M'
mapper.insert: insert into tb_daily_mst ( daily_date, type_cd, area_cd, work_type_cd, end_yn, reg_id, upd_id) values (convert(date, getdate(), 23), #{typeCd}, #{areaCd}, #{workTypeCd}, 'n', #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: select CONVERT(date, getdate(), 23) as daily_date ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.tran_id, b.item_cd) AS order_dist ,b.item_cd ,dbo.getCustomerName(a.customer_cd) as customer_Name ,i.item_name ,i.spec ,b.qty ,b.in_price ,b.supply_price ,i.expiry_date ,'' as etc from tb_inv_tran_mst a join tb_inv_tran_item b on a.tran_id = b.tran_id and b.item_type_cd = #{itemTypeCd} join tb_item_mst i on i.item_cd = b.item_cd where a.tran_date = DATEADD(day, -1, GETDATE()) and a.tran_type_cd = #{tranTypeCd}

SELECT CONVERT(date, getdate(), 23) as daily_date ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.work_proc_id, a.item_cd) AS order_dist ,a.item_cd ,cl.client_name as customer_name ,c.item_name ,b.lot_no ,a.order_qty ,x.bom_price ,a.order_qty * x.bom_price AS total_price ,dbo.getStorageByAreaCd(a.storage_cd) as area_name ,'' as etc FROM TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a JOIN TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH b ON b.work_batch_id = a.work_batch_id join TB_WORK_ORDER_MST m on m.work_order_id = a.work_batch_id left join tb_client_mst cl on cl.client_id = m.client_id JOIN tb_item_mst c ON c.item_cd = a.item_cd LEFT JOIN tb_customer d ON d.customer_cd = c.customer_cd CROSS APPLY ( SELECT a.order_qty * SUM(r.real_content * m.in_price) / 1000 AS bom_price FROM tb_bom_mst bm JOIN tb_bom_recipe r ON bm.bom_id = r.bom_id JOIN tb_item_mst m ON m.item_cd = r.item_cd WHERE bm.default_yn = 'Y' AND bm.item_cd = a.item_cd ) x WHERE a.proc_cd = 'PRC001' AND a.proc_status = '12' and convert(date, a.work_end_time, 23) = DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE())

select CONVERT(date, getdate(), 23) as daily_date ,c.item_cd ,dbo.getCustomerName(i.customer_cd) as customer_name ,i.item_name ,c.weigh_qty ,i.in_price ,c.weigh_qty*i.in_price as tot_price ,'' as etc from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a join tb_weigh_info b on a.work_proc_id = b.work_proc_id join tb_weigh_inv c on b.weigh_id = c.weigh_id join tb_item_mst i on i.item_cd = c.item_cd where a.proc_cd = 'PRC001' and convert(date, a.work_end_time, 23) = DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) and a.proc_status = '52'

SELECT a.daily_date ,ISNULL(b.inQty, 0) AS inQty ,ISNULL(b.returnQty, 0) AS returnQty ,ISNULL(b.disQty, 0) AS discardQty ,ISNULL(d.usePrice, 0) AS useQty ,a.daily_id ,a.end_yn ,a.reg_id ,a.type_cd FROM tb_daily_mst a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT daily_id ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'A' THEN ISNULL(in_price, 0) * isnull(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS inQty ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'P' THEN ISNULL(in_price, 0) * isnull(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS returnQty ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'G' THEN ISNULL(in_price, 0) * isnull(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS disQty FROM tb_daily_M2 GROUP BY daily_id ) b ON a.daily_id = b.daily_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT daily_id ,SUM(ISNULL(required_quantity, 0) * ISNULL(in_price, 0)) AS usePrice FROM tb_daily_sub_use GROUP BY daily_id ) d ON a.daily_id = d.daily_id WHERE a.daily_date between #{strDate} and #{endDate} and a.type_cd = 'S'

WITH BOM AS ( SELECT a.item_cd AS bom_item_cd ,b.item_cd AS sub_item_cd ,b.qty ,i.in_price FROM tb_bom_mst a INNER JOIN tb_bom_recipe b ON b.bom_id = a.bom_id INNER JOIN tb_item_mst i ON i.item_cd = b.item_cd AND i.item_type_cd = 'M2' WHERE a.default_yn = 'Y' ), WORK_ITEM AS ( SELECT DISTINCT po_no ,item_cd AS bom_item_cd FROM TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC WHERE proc_cd IN ('PRC004', 'PRC005') -- AND CONVERT(date, work_end_time) = CONVERT(date, DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE())) ), PROD AS ( SELECT po_no ,item_cd AS packing_item_cd ,SUM(prod_qty) AS prod_qty FROM TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC WHERE proc_status = '52' GROUP BY po_no ,item_cd ) SELECT dbo.getItemName(p.packing_item_cd) AS item_name ,p.prod_qty ,dbo.getItemName(b.sub_item_cd) AS bom_name ,CASE WHEN i.item_type_cd != 'M0' THEN 0 ELSE b.qty END AS requiredQuantity ,b.in_price ,p.packing_item_cd ,b.sub_item_cd FROM WORK_ITEM w INNER JOIN PROD p ON p.po_no = w.po_no INNER JOIN tb_item_mst i ON i.item_cd = w.bom_item_cd INNER JOIN BOM b ON b.bom_item_cd = w.bom_item_cd ORDER BY p.packing_item_cd ,b.sub_item_cd

select case when a.proc_cd in ('PRC001', 'PRC002', 'PRC003') then b.make_no else b.lot_no end as lot_no ,cl.client_name ,i.item_name ,a.prod_qty ,CASE WHEN r.work_start_time IS NULL OR r.work_end_time IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT( RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, r.work_start_time, r.work_end_time) / 60 AS varchar(10)), 2), ':', RIGHT('00' + CAST(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, r.work_start_time, r.work_end_time) % 60 AS varchar(2)), 2) )END AS work_time ,isnull(r.worker_cnt, 0) as worker_cnt ,a.proc_cd from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a join TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH b on b.work_batch_id = a.work_batch_id join TB_WORK_ORDER_MST c on c.work_order_id = a.work_order_id left join tb_work_record r on r.work_proc_id = a.work_proc_id join tb_item_mst i on i.item_cd = a.item_cd left join tb_client_mst cl on cl.client_id = c.client_id where convert(date, a.work_end_time, 23) = DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) and a.proc_cd = #{procCd} and a.proc_status = #{procStatus}

SELECT a.daily_date ,ISNULL(b.inQty, 0) AS inQty ,ISNULL(b.returnQty, 0) AS returnQty ,ISNULL(b.discardQty, 0) AS discardQty ,ISNULL(b.outQty, 0) AS outQty ,ISNULL(b.outExpense, 0) AS outExpense ,ISNULL(b.shipmentQty, 0) AS shipmentQty ,a.daily_id ,a.end_yn ,a.reg_id ,a.type_cd FROM tb_daily_mst a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT daily_id ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'A' THEN isnull(in_price, 0)*ISNULL(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS inQty ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'P' THEN isnull(in_price, 0)*ISNULL(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS returnQty ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'G' THEN isnull(in_price, 0)*ISNULL(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS discardQty ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'O' THEN isnull(in_price, 0)*ISNULL(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS outQty ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'E' THEN isnull(in_price, 0)*ISNULL(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS outExpense ,SUM(CASE WHEN tran_type_cd = 'F' THEN isnull(in_price, 0)*ISNULL(qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS shipmentQty FROM tb_daily_M0 GROUP BY daily_id ) b ON a.daily_id = b.daily_id WHERE a.daily_date between #{strDate} and #{endDate} and a.type_cd = 'P'
SELECT a.* ,b.daily_date AS dailyDate FROM tb_daily_mgmt a JOIN tb_daily_mst b ON a.daily_id = b.daily_id WHERE b.type_cd = 'M' AND a.daily_id = #{dailyId}
